devdoc.details: This contract isolates V4-specific approval, action encoding, dust accounting, and position ownership checks from launch administration. Only the factory may execute a migration.

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

params.factory_: Launch factory authorised to call mintFullRangePosition.
params.initializationHook_: No-fee hook restricting pool initialization to the factory.
params.positionManager_: Uniswap V4 PositionManager wired to poolManager_.
params.protocolFeeRecipient_: Beneficiary for migration dust and recovered foreign native ETH.

flushQuoteDust(address).details: Failed transfers revert the pending amount and remain retryable after pool creation.

mintFullRangePosition(address,address,ui.details: Currencies are sorted by address and the PoolKey contains the initialization-only guard. The executor snapshots its own and PositionManager's pre-existing balances so foreign native ETH returned by SWEEP is never attributed to the current launch. Temporary approvals are cleared on success.

params.pairToken: Quote asset; address(0) represents native ETH.
params.poolFee: Static V4 LP fee encoded in the PoolKey.
params.quoteAmount: Quote asset allocated to the position.
params.tickSpacing: Tick spacing encoded in the PoolKey.
params.tokenAmount: Token amount allocated to the position.

returns.result: Position identifier, price, liquidity, seeded amounts, and rounding dust.

userdoc.notice: Mints a full-range native-ETH or ERC-20 quote V4 position directly to the immutable launch locker.

locker().notice: Permanent recipient of every minted liquidity position.

factory().notice: Launch factory authorised to invoke pool creation.

permit2().notice: Permit2 instance used by PositionManager to pull launched tokens.

poolManager().notice: Uniswap V4 pool registry and accounting manager.

initializationHook().notice: Initialization-only hook embedded in every graduated PoolKey.

protocolFeeRecipient().notice: Beneficiary credited with migration dust and recovered foreign native ETH.

flushQuoteDust(address).notice: Permissionlessly transfers accumulated ERC-20 quote dust to the fixed escrow beneficiary.

pendingQuoteDust(address).notice: Unflushed ERC-20 quote dust, excluding pre-existing donations.

mintFullRangePosition(address,address,ui.notice: Mints a full-range position into the factory-initialized V4 pool.

devdoc.title: Clank Uniswap V4 graduation executor

SafeERC20FailedOperation(address).details: An operation with an ERC-20 token failed.

devdoc.details: This contract isolates V4-specific approval, action encoding, dust accounting, and position ownership checks from launch administration. Only the factory may execute a migration.

params.factory_: Launch factory authorised to call mintFullRangePosition.
params.positionManager_: Uniswap V4 PositionManager wired to poolManager_.
params.initializationHook_: No-fee hook restricting pool initialization to the factory.
params.protocolFeeRecipient_: Beneficiary for migration dust and recovered foreign native ETH.

flushQuoteDust(address).details: Failed transfers revert the pending amount and remain retryable after pool creation.

params.poolFee: Static V4 LP fee encoded in the PoolKey.
params.pairToken: Quote asset; address(0) represents native ETH.
params.quoteAmount: Quote asset allocated to the position.
params.tickSpacing: Tick spacing encoded in the PoolKey.
params.tokenAmount: Token amount allocated to the position.

mintFullRangePosition(address,address,ui.details: Currencies are sorted by address and the PoolKey contains the initialization-only guard. The executor snapshots its own and PositionManager's pre-existing balances so foreign native ETH returned by SWEEP is never attributed to the current launch. Temporary approvals are cleared on success.

returns.result: Position identifier, price, liquidity, seeded amounts, and rounding dust.
